objective: Kiểm toán đối kháng cuối phiên (S5 / DG3) đối chiếu mã nguồn thực tế sau khi sửa của TargetConnectionsDrawer.tsx, masterConnectionForm.ts, và MasterRegistry.tsx

claims.claim: In TargetConnectionsDrawer.tsx lines 41-80, TargetConnectionsTable omits standalone Engine and Display Name columns, rendering connection_code on row 1 with display_name on row 2 in 'Mã & Tên hiển thị' and MasterEngineIcon + meta.shortLabel on row 1 with formatMasterConnectionHostPort on row 2 in 'Engine & Host : Port'.

In masterConnectionForm.ts lines 74-90, formatMasterConnectionHostPort returns '(mặc định hệ thống)' when rawHost is empty and checks /:\d+$/ on each comma-separated host segment before appending resolvedPort.

In TargetConnectionsDrawer.tsx lines 81-153, TargetConnectionsTable preserves Database / Schema, Status, and Actions (Test, Edit, and Popconfirm deactivation hidden for default and default_master) on a top-aligned-table with useMemo declared unconditionally at top level.

In MasterRegistry.tsx lines 1-32 and 1551-1565, unused imports Drawer, Popconfirm, and DeleteOutlined are removed and the inline Drawer is replaced by TargetConnectionsDrawer with zero new if/else branches.
In TargetConnectionsDrawer.tsx lines 155-197, TargetConnectionsDrawer passes size={840} to AntD Drawer instead of the deprecated width prop.
In index.css lines 48-51, .top-aligned-table .ant-table-cell sets vertical-align: top !important.
In TargetConnectionsDrawer.tsx lines 41-80, TargetConnectionsTable sets ellipsis: true on connection_code and host_port and still renders a separate Engine column.
In TargetConnectionsDrawer.tsx lines 101-138, TargetConnectionsTable allows Popconfirm deactivation on the default_master connection.
